commands: echo "GITHUB_ACTIONS=${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-<unset>}"; echo "GITHUB_RUN_ID=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-<unset>}"; echo "---deps---"; gh issue view 1048 --json number,state,title 2>&1 | head -20; echo "---branch---"; git branch --show-current

scripts/verification_baseline.py --help 2>&1 | head -30; echo "==="; grep -n "def \|checkout_id\|index_digest\|tracked_digest\|untracked_digest\|argv\|external_services" scripts/verification_baseline.py | head -30
echo "HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"; echo "TREE=$(git write-tree)"; echo "ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID=$(scripts/run-jq.sh -r '.comment.id // empty' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -z "$TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID" ]; then
  TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID=$(gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/1049/comments?per_page=100" --jq 'map(select((.body | contains("/prflow:implement")) and ((.body | test("(pr|dev)flow:workpad")) | not))) | last | .id' 2>/dev/null || true)
fi
echo "TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID=$TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID"

rm -f "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)/.prflow/tmp/implement-active-1049" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)/.prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1049.md" 2>/dev/null || true; echo "cleanup done"

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
